pose_contract.body: A-pose, palms down, five separated digits; profile views provide finger separation
pose_contract.other_pieces: Fit the same body/head; no independent arm pose applies

fit_contract.instruction: Use the approved 1.90 m assembled silhouette as scale reference. Rig the body, then measure and uniformly fit pieces to that body in T-pose. Never normalize every component independently to 1.90 m, and never infer metre dimensions by equating separate source image heights. Reconstructed metric fit remains untested.
fit_contract.base_head_occlusion: The body contains a bald head for the auto-rigger. Hide/remove it beneath the replaceable head so it cannot occlude the mouth cavity.

slot_ownership.hat: tricorn plus one red plume, attached consistently on wearer-left
slot_ownership.face: one moustache and a tiny separate chin tuft; no sideburns or skin
slot_ownership.shirt: ivory collar and white wrist frills
slot_ownership.coat: dark coat, gold trim, brass fastenings, red cuffs and red lining
slot_ownership.waist: red sash only; no invented leather belt

extraction.upscale_step: Native crops are not resampled in verification; apply the documented 2x upscale before Tripo. Minimum resulting side across this set is 1202 px.

status: All ten source slots delivered. The engine side has verified the reconstructed head mouth, teeth and tongue; head texture/rig and the remaining reconstruction, fitting and simulation work are still open. Source acceptance limits are recorded in completion_audit.

remaining_source_requirements: A common pixels-per-metre scale and measured physical fit have not been demonstrated. The recorded dimensions remain provisional fitting guides.
The hat head opening and sash waist opening do not expose background in two source views. The strict source-hole requirement remains unmet; their reconstructed cavities must be checked.
Native sheets other than the body retain the small height/baseline differences recorded per slot. Extraction aligns baselines but does not remove source height differences.
completion_audit.body_headless_redo: withdrawn by engine side; retain the delivered scaffold head
completion_audit.next_step: Continue the existing engine reconstruction/fit tasks and report any required source corrections through HANDOFF.md.
